rationale_summary: The timeline document frames AI governance primarily around staged safety regulation—prohibitions, high-risk system rules, transparency obligations, and enforcement—suggesting a consumer and public safety orientation. Secondary frames include innovation enablement (regulatory sandboxes, support tools) and implicit fundamental rights concerns via transparency and prohibitions.

evidence_spans.quote: Rules for high-risk AI systems in Annex III enter into application
Measures in support of innovation start apply
Member States should have at least one AI regulatory sandbox per country established
General provisions (definitions & AI literacy) and prohibitions apply
